OAT-06/S22.title: Code and doc read: the hand-off doc and field names, Nursing Home removal, the end-of-pilot survey
OAT-06/S22.detail: Code and doc read at 43c38a4f (git reads of the QA worktree; no browser, no backend). Judged 2 of 4 pass. ① FAILED, T1 / TFA-94514 AC 9: the hand-off doc for Vikram is gone. #86's last commit (43c38a4f 'chore(docs): drop the docs folder; what it said lives in the code', after Tim's review) deleted docs/pilot-analytics.md; docs/ now holds only billing-acceptance-review.md, billing-topology.md and mobile-e2e.md, and no file in the repo names pilotDailyRounding, pilotUsageEvents, patientActivityEvents or surveyResponses. What is left for a reader is the field names and the schema comments (TFA-94514's notes foresaw it: 'If it merges, the AC 9 hand-off doc needs another home'). Where the doc lives now, and whether Vikram has it, needs Tim / Vikram (Q9). ③ FAILED, TFA-94514 AC 1 / U2 (known B24): no Nursing Home screen removes a resident: useSnfActions exposes remove (src/data/snf.ts:36) but its only screen user takes add (src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx:26), and nothing under src/routes/snf or src/features/snf calls remove, so a nursing_home patient_removed row can never come from the app. ④ PASSED (fixed by #86), TFA-94514 AC 2 / U9a: the end-of-pilot task-reminder survey exists (convex/surveys.ts:29 task_reminder; TaskReminderSurveyCard.tsx, mounted in PilotSurveyCards.tsx) and stores its answer (S14 C). PASSED, TFA-94609 AC 6 / U12: answer keys and values are named for a reader — baseline patientsPerDay / preRoundMinutesPerPatientBefore / noteMinutesPerPatientBefore / patientListMethodBefore / writtenHandoffFrequencyBefore / comments with values such as under_5, 5_to_10, phone_notes, most_days; moreLikelyToSendHandoff yes / no / not_sure; rating + comment; dismissedTaskRemindersBecause mostly_did_it / mixed / mostly_noise + comments; surveyDismissals {userId, survey} timed by _creationTime; pilotSettings {key taskReminderSurveyFrom, value}. Recorded: ② aiCallLog's fields are explained only by schema comments (convex/schema.ts 230-251); httpStatus, promptChars, responseChars and error are explained nowhere; the pilot-end command is written only in a code comment (convex/surveys.ts:187).
OAT-06/S22.productIssue: In Nursing Home there is still no way to remove a resident (B24), so a Nursing Home removal never reaches the analytics. For the pilot team: the hand-off doc that told Vikram how to read the analytics tables (docs/pilot-analytics.md) was deleted with docs/ by #86 and nothing in the repo replaces it.
